response.evidence: Build your Astro site with your preferred package manager:
response.rationale: In the CLI Deployment section, step 1 installs the Deno Deploy CLI and step 2 is to build the site with your package manager. Step 3 is 'Run deployctl to deploy!', so building comes before running the deploy tool. The combined build-and-deploy script is only an optional step after that, and pushing to GitHub belongs to the GitHub Actions route.
